subject.title: [Performance] Duplicate parsing of CA certificates in node-extra-ca-certs.ts on every connection

question: Should this fresh report receive a short window to provide a current-main profile proving repeated CA-file reads or parsing, or close now because the described OpenClaw path is not reproducible from source and Node's startup contract?
rationale: Source and dependency contracts contradict the reported mechanism, but only a runtime trace can rule out an indirect caller or different TLS path with complete confidence.

options.title: Allow a bounded evidence window
options.body: Keep the issue open briefly and require a current-main CPU profile, filesystem trace, stack sample, or reproducible benchmark that identifies the repeated operation.

options.title: Close as not reproduced
options.body: Close now because the named helper resolves a path rather than parsing certificates and Node owns startup-time loading.

recommendation.title: Allow a bounded evidence window
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open briefly and require a current-main CPU profile, filesystem trace, stack sample, or reproducible benchmark that identifies the repeated operation.
